## lookback-functions

Lookback functions may read data in the past to determine the current value. They are evaluated by quote for a single security.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `AOH(num, high)` |  |
| `CVAR(chance, duration, calc)` |  |
| `DIRECTION(numberOfPeriods, expression)` | If the prior different value was higher then the current value then return 1, if the prior different value was lower then the current value then return -1, if all prior values within numberOfPeriods was the same then return 0. |
| `EMA(num, calc)` |  |
| `HIGHEST(n_periods, calc)` |  |
| `LOWEST(num, calc)` |  |
| `LRS(n, expression)` | Linear Regression Slope as a percentage |
| `OFFSET(n_periods, calc)` |  |
| `PAST(days, calc)` | Anchor data to N × 24hours ago |
| `PF(num, calc)` |  |
| `PRIOR(days, field)` | Include only data upto N days ago (As of N days ago) |
| `R2(n, expression)` | R-squared as a percentage |
| `RSI(num, calc)` |  |
| `SESSION(calc)` |  |
| `SINCE(days, calc)` | Anchor data to the start of day, N days ago |
| `SMA(num, calc)` |  |
| `STDEV(num, calc)` |  |
| `TOD(calc)` |  |
| `VAR(chance, duration, calc)` |  |

## indicator-functions

Indicator functions must be prefixed by an interval and a dot (such as `day.ATR(14)`) and take numbers as parameters.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `ATR(n)` |  |
| `OBV(n)` |  |
| `POPV(numberOfPeriods, percentOfVolumeBelowPrice)` | Estimated Price with the given Percent of Volume traded below it |
| `POVO(numberOfPeriodsToInclude, [offsetNumberOfPeriods])` | Percent of trade Volume below current bar close Oscillator |
| `PSAR(factor, limit, n)` |  |
| `ROF(n)` |  |
| `SAB(factor, limit, n)` |  |
| `SAS(factor, limit, n)` |  |

## rolling-functions

Rolling functions read values of previous rows across the whole portfolio and are available in collect (and the layers above it).

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `COUNTPREC([columnName, [numberOfIntervals, [criteria]]])` | Counts the number of retained values that preceed this value |
| `COUNTPREV([columnName, [numberOfValues, [criteria]]])` | Returns the sum of columnName values from the previous numberOfValues retained |
| `COUNTTOTAL([column])` | Counts the number of retained values |
| `LOOKUP(columnName, criteria)` | Returns the value of columnName of a row that matches criteria |
| `MAXPREC(columnName, [numberOfIntervals, [criteria]])` | Returns the maximum of all numeric values that preceed this |
| `MAXPREV(columnName, [numberOfValues, [criteria]])` | Returns the maximum of columnName values from the previous numberOfValues retained |
| `MAXTOTAL(column)` | Returns the maximum of all numeric values |
| `MEDIANTOTAL(column)` | Returns the median of a set of numbers. In a set containing an uneven number of values, the median will be the number in the middle of the set and in a set containing an even number of values, it will be the mean of the two values in the middle of the set. |
| `MINPREC(columnName, [numberOfIntervals, [criteria]])` | Returns the minimum of all numeric values that preceed this |
| `MINPREV(columnName, [numberOfValues, [criteria]])` | Returns the minimum of columnName values from the previous numberOfValues retained |
| `MINTOTAL(column)` | Returns the minimum of all numeric values |
| `PREC(columnName, defaultValue)` | Returns the value of columnName from the preceeding retained value |
| `PREV(columnName, defaultValue)` | Returns the value of columnName from the previous retained value for this security |
| `STDEVTOTAL(column)` | Estimates the standard deviation based on all numeric values |
| `SUMPREC(columnName, [numberOfIntervals, [criteria]])` | Returns the sum of all numeric values that preceed this |
| `SUMPREV(columnName, [numberOfValues, [criteria]])` | Returns the sum of columnName values from the previous numberOfValues retained |
| `SUMTOTAL(column)` | Returns the sum of all numeric values |

## quoting-functions

Quoting functions are available in collect columns and compare or adjust securities across the portfolio.

| Function | Description |
|---|---|
| `DIVIDEND(symbol, market, [reference-date,] exdate [, risk-free-rate])` | Dividend value per share for shareholders who owned one stock on reference date and held until exdate |
| `MAXCORREL(duration, expression, [criteria])` | Maximum correlation coefficient among other securities |
| `SPLIT(symbol, market, [reference-date,] exdate)` | Number of shares on exdate for every share on reference date (X-for-1 split) |
